data.title: This video explores the integration of the Mixtral
data.content:
## Summary
This video explores the integration of the Mixtral 8x7B Mixture of Experts model into the Brave browser's AI assistant, Leo, and its search engine. It highlights how this shift from Llama 2 provides users with high-performance, privacy-focused AI capabilities for summarization and coding assistance directly within the browser.

## Key Points
- Brave has updated its AI assistant, Leo, to use the Mixtral 8x7B model, replacing Llama 2 70B.
- The integration is available in two forms: Brave Leo (sidebar assistant) and Code LLM (integrated into Brave Search).
- Mixtral 8x7B is a Sparse Mixture of Experts model that performs at a level equivalent to GPT-3.5 Turbo.
- Leo can summarize web pages and YouTube videos (via transcripts) and handle follow-up questions.
- The features are hosted by Brave, meaning users do not need a local GPU to run the models.
- Brave Search's Code LLM provides programming answers with confidence scores based on top K/P values.

## AI Concepts
Mixture of Experts (MoE), Sparse Mixture of Experts, Transformers architecture, Large Language Models (LLM), Token processing, Model quantization/scaling, Prompt engineering
